headline: The shop says Monday through Thursday 7:30 to 5:30. Google still opens Friday at 7.
summary: This is a real fencing, ornamental metals, gates, and mobile welding shop at 607 Brazos Street, Suite A in Ramona. Kyle and Tayla already show up in the reviews. Google Maps is live this week at 5.0 stars from about 16 reviews, open Monday through Friday 7 to 5:30. The shop this week prints kyle@ramonametalworks.com, (760) 975-9869, and Monday through Thursday 7:30 to 5:30. Leftover directories still open the week at 7. A neighbor planning a Friday gate drop or a 7 a.m. walk-in can trust the leftover card and find a door that is not the shop week.
